title: Grateful Dead Live at Springer's Inn Portland on 1970-01-16
source: Source: sbd > reel master > reel > pcm (sony beta tape ESX-HiFi/L-750) - Given to Tim Dalton by the late Harvey Lubar; Transfer: pcm > Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (WAV 16-bit/44.1k) - transferred by Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick February 2018

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of decent quality captures a primo early‑70 Dead performance highlighted by a fiery China>Rider jam.
ai_review.review: The show is praised as "primo Dead" with Jerry Garcia digging the new China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider transition, giving the concert an exciting early‑70 vibe. Reviewers note the recording is rough in the typical way for this era but overall good, and no specific sound issues are reported.

ai_rating.rationale: Three positive reviews (5, 4, 4 stars) highlight a strong performance and an acceptable recording; weighted rating yields ~4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not comment on clarity or mix; the .sbd suffix suggests a typical soundboard source that is generally clear.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set pacing; reviewers emphasize the raw early‑70 energy and a strong China>Rider sequence.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted as "really digging this new China>Rider thing" indicating enthusiastic playing.
